headlines.description: — Brandon Miller scored 34 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the winless Miami Heat 115-110 on Saturday, bouncing back from one of the worst losses in franchise history a night earlier.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brandon Miller scores 34 points as the Hornets beat the winless Heat 115-110
